title: Camera
drDigitalIntro:
Most laptops have a built-in camera at the very top of the screen.
• The camera is that tiny dot or slit sitting right above the display — easy to miss!
• It lets you take photos, record videos, and video call friends and family.
• Some people connect a separate external camera for a better picture quality.
• When an app is using your camera, a small green or orange dot appears near the camera to let you know it is on.
• Note: the activities in this course use a simulated camera, so your real camera never turns on.
drDigitalSuccess: That's your camera! You'll use it later when we practice video calls.
drDigitalHint: Just look at the top edge of your own screen — that tiny dot is your camera. Click Continue when you're ready.
